precomputation_disclosure: Before this analysis-method freeze, source integrity and record schema were inspected and one observation was inspected to resolve field structure. No cell-level, block-level, policy-level, treatment-level, or endpoint aggregate outcome summary was computed before this freeze.

recovery_rmst_s.source: time_to_evidence_qualified_trusted_recovery_s with administrative right-censoring at 240 logical seconds
recovery_rmst_s.definition: mean min(T,240); with only common administrative censoring at 240 this equals the empirical Kaplan-Meier RMST through 240

recovery_terminal_state.analysis: descriptive state counts and proportions only; no post-hoc scalarization

cell_estimation.binary: event count, rate, and two-sided Wilson 95% interval with z=1.959963984540054
cell_estimation.continuous: sample mean and deterministic nonparametric bootstrap percentile 95% interval
cell_estimation.bootstrap_rng: Python random.Random seeded independently from the first 64 bits of SHA256('S2-P7-BOOTSTRAP|' + estimand_id)
cell_estimation.bootstrap_percentile: linear interpolation at p=0.025 and 0.975 using h=(B-1)p

paired_contrast_estimation.effect: mean within-seed difference, test minus reference
paired_contrast_estimation.confidence_interval: deterministic paired nonparametric bootstrap percentile 95% interval over paired seed differences, 20000 replicates
paired_contrast_estimation.secondary_raw_p: two-sided exact paired sign test over nonzero within-seed differences; ties excluded
paired_contrast_estimation.primary_p_values: NOT_USED; primary estimands are reported as effect sizes with 95% confidence intervals
paired_contrast_estimation.pairing_failure: fail closed if seed sets, seed ordering, or one-to-one membership do not match exactly

primary_estimands.mechanism_effects: Within each of the three Block-A policies and each primary endpoint, V1, V2, V3, V4, and V5 are each contrasted against V0 using exact paired A96 seeds; effect is adverse-profile minus V0.
primary_estimands.policy_effects: Within each of the six Block-A evidence profiles and each primary endpoint, S2_S1_EVIDENCE_AWARE is contrasted against S2_B0_FAIL_CLOSED and S2_B2_RISK_THRESHOLD using exact paired A96 seeds; effect is S2_S1 minus baseline.
primary_estimands.multiplicity: No multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis declarations for primary estimands; report effect sizes and 95% intervals without a weighted/global policy score.

B_CONTACT_AUTHORIZATION.ordered_trend: For each policy, seed, and scalar endpoint, least-squares slope across contact scores K0=0,K1=1,K2=2,K3=3. Report mean per-seed slope and paired-bootstrap 95% CI. Policy-by-contact interaction is S2_S1 slope minus each baseline-policy slope within seed.
B_CONTACT_AUTHORIZATION.K4_intermittent: K4 minus K0 within policy and seed. Policy-by-K4 interaction is the difference-in-differences: (S2_S1 K4-K0) minus (baseline K4-K0). K4 is never encoded as ordinal score 4.
B_CONTACT_AUTHORIZATION.holm_families: For each scalar endpoint separately: B_ORDERED contains four policy slopes plus three S2_S1-vs-baseline slope interactions; B_K4 contains four policy K4-K0 contrasts plus three S2_S1-vs-baseline difference-in-differences.

C_FAULT_ATTACK_AMBIGUITY.contrast: ADVERSARIAL minus BENIGN within ambiguity family, policy, seed, and scalar endpoint.
C_FAULT_ATTACK_AMBIGUITY.holm_families: For each scalar endpoint separately, all 3 ambiguity families x 3 policies = 9 contrasts form one C_AMBIGUITY family.

D_CONTEXT_ABLATION.contrast: Each PI_NO_MISSION, PI_NO_EVIDENCE, PI_NO_CONTACT, and PI_SECURITY_ONLY selector minus S2_S1_EVIDENCE_AWARE within context, seed, and scalar endpoint.
D_CONTEXT_ABLATION.holm_families: For each scalar endpoint separately, all 4 contexts x 4 ablations = 16 contrasts form one D_ABLATION family.

E_ADVERSARY_BUDGET_STRESS.pairwise: Within policy, seed, and scalar endpoint report A2/K2 minus A1/K0 and A3/K0 minus A1/K0. A2/K2 is explicitly labeled contact-coupled and is not interpreted as an unconfounded adversary-only effect.
E_ADVERSARY_BUDGET_STRESS.ordered_summary: Within policy and seed, report least-squares slope across profile scores A1=1,A2=2,A3=3 as a descriptive ordered stress summary, retaining the explicit A2 contact-coupling caveat.
E_ADVERSARY_BUDGET_STRESS.holm_families: For each scalar endpoint separately, 3 policies x [A2-A1, A3-A1, ordered slope] = 9 contrasts form one E_STRESS family.

holm_adjustment.implementation: sort raw p ascending; adjusted_i=max(previous_adjusted,(m-rank+1)*p_i), capped at 1; map back to original rows
holm_adjustment.scope: only within the named secondary family and endpoint; never across unrelated blocks/endpoints

integrity_checks_before_analysis: artifact ZIP SHA-256 must match frozen Phase-6 provenance
all internal file SHA-256 values must match evidence_hashes.json
attempt ledger must contain exactly 3872 VALID and 0 INVALID attempts
observations must contain exactly 3872 VALID records
run_id and trial_id must be globally unique
cell/seed membership must equal the frozen 85-cell manifest exactly
oracle_was_selector_input must be false for every observation
automatic_retry_allowed and automatic_next_trial_allowed must be false for every observation
all recovery censor horizons must equal 240 logical seconds
prohibitions: no endpoint redefinition after aggregate outcomes are computed
no operational spacecraft or RF claims
no interpretation of logical SIL seconds as measured spacecraft wall-clock latency
